description_en: The apartment has a gross area of ​​52.1 m2 and a net area of ​​45.70, located on the 2nd floor. It is very well furnished and ready for living or investment. The property has a mortgage and offers a secure purchase process. Suitable for couple, small family or for rental investment. The price is 90,000 euros.
